# BridgeBuilder HRMS | Product Overview

BridgeBuilder HRMS is the HRMS of Hong Kong under the flag of FlexSystem, for complex local pay, vacation time and Asia and the Pacific. The core of the product is to create a unified workspace around staff, recruitment, pay/leave time or talent management, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
